Futures 2040 MTP

The story maps provided highlight information from the Mid-Region Metropolitan Planning Organization's 2040 MTP, called Futures 2040. Futures 2040 introduces a mechanism known as scenario planning to consider the multiple ways in which the region could grow over time and understand the costs and benefits associated with different development patterns. Past MTPs projected future conditions based on anticipated projected population and employment growth and existing plans and policies, and responded to the challenges identified in the projections. In contrast, the Futures 2040 MTP proactively looks at an alternative way for the region to grow that help us mitigate some of the costs associated with growth. If you would like to make any comments regarding these story maps please contact Caeri Thomas (cthomas@mrcog-nm.gov). Graphics for the story maps are produced in-house by Madia Rubin.


About Us

Housed in the Mid-Region Council of Governments (MRCOG), the Mid-Region Metropolitan Planning Organization (MRMPO) does transportation planning for the Albuquerque Metropolitan Planning Area (AMPA). MPOs are required by federal law for all urbanized areas with populations greater than 50,000. Activities undertaken by the MRMPO include traffic monitoring and traffic counts, analysis of current socio-economic conditions and development of forecasts, travel demand forecasting, roadway safety analysis, transportation accessibility modeling, scenario planning, and mapping (GIS). This information is used to develop a regional 20-year long-range transportation plan, the Metropolitan Transportation Plan (MTP), and the short-term Transportation Improvement Program (TIP).
